result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but there is one clear content/logic defect (a '-0%' discount badge), inconsistent image and icon treatments across cards, and a low-contrast search placeholder. Horizontal clipping of the last carousel item and the cut-off card at the viewport bottom were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) shows a promo badge reading '-0%', which is a meaningless discount value and looks like a rendering/data bug.
issues.suggestion: Suppress the discount badge when the computed discount is 0 or null; only render badges for valid positive discounts (e.g. '-20%') or fall back to another label such as '€0 delivery'.

issues.description: The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail (Green Bowl Poké) uses a light gray background with the plate illustration pushed to the right and cropped at the bottom, while the other thumbnails use dark, fully centered imagery. It reads as a broken/unloaded or improperly fitted image.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image aspect ratio and object-fit (cover, centered) plus a uniform placeholder/background color for all carousel thumbnails so no artwork is clipped or off-center.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: on the ramen card the heart sits directly on the image with no backing, while on the pizza card it has a dark circular scrim. The unbacked heart has poor contrast against light image areas.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent circular background (and identical size/position) to all favorite buttons to guarantee contrast and visual consistency.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving a contrast ratio well below 4.5:1 and making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (e.g. #6B7280 or darker) or lighten the field background to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only name and delivery fee, with no rating or cuisine info, whereas 'Popular right now' cards show rating, time and cuisine — the missing metadata makes the two rows feel inconsistent and gives less decision-making info.
issues.suggestion: Add rating and cuisine (or an explicit 'New' label when no rating exists) to the fastest carousel cards for consistent information density.
